lines: Increases the size or reach of supported attacks and effects. It does not increase their damage; area damage is separate. An area never reaches through walls: an explosion, a ground slam, a burst or a chain hits only those with nothing solid between them and its centre.

lines: A Lord's Brand ascends any piece of equipment to the biome after its boss. Weapons (pickaxes too), shields, armour and summoning staves: base damage (in the item's own damage types), durability, block and armour rise to that biome's items of the same kind and slot - nothing goes down; a summoning staff's minion becomes as strong as that biome's creatures. Their workbench upgrades start over at quality 1 and then cost what that biome's reference item costs. Properties, sockets, sigils and implicits stay. Equipment with nothing to compare - rings, belts, amulets, trinkets, utility items, capes without armour, other tools - gains only item level, unlocking higher property tiers on future rolls; its properties, implicit effects, base stats, durability and quality remain unchanged. One brand per item, and only upward.
new.name: Ascension

lines: The Wishbone, the Wisplight and the Dvergr lanterns are Magic at most: one prefix and one suffix, rolled from each item's own pool (its detection range, its mist-clearing area, its light and warmth, and a few common rows). They take no sockets and no quality: nothing on them scales with it. A Lord's Brand still raises their item level, which opens higher tiers for the next roll.
new.name: Utility items
